scripts.test:rules: node scripts/configure.mjs --test && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,database "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:int: node scripts/configure.mjs --test && npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database "vitest run tests/integration --mode emulator --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=30000"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/configure.mjs --test && vite build --mode emulator && npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database "playwright test"
scripts.deploy: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npx firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,database
scripts.preview:local: node scripts/configure.mjs --test && npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database --ui "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && vite --mode emulator --host"
